## Tournament chess piece sets

The Tournament Staunton and Heritage Staunton collections use the Livius and Meridian complete-piece sets by Martin Sedlák, pinned to commit `af40ea51e87eddee1ae7ee35ae312893a1271233`.

Source: https://github.com/kmar/chess_svg_piece_sets/tree/af40ea51e87eddee1ae7ee35ae312893a1271233

Downloaded archive SHA-256: `4a890623acb03e1cd2f313653dce635b981c6d28b7fa5baea06ef8c0228d1976`.

License: CC0 / public domain dedication. See `LICENSE-chess-svg-piece-sets.txt`.

The published SVGs are sanitized, recolorable derivatives generated by `tools/build-tshirt-artwork-catalog.py`. No runtime request is made to the upstream repository.
